record.field: Upload, download and browse files on storage backends; stage uploads for downstream tools to consume by file_id.

Deprecated for new integrations: prefer the `attachment_*` tools from llm_mcp_server (ir.attachment ids, no backend/path, no list tools). The `storage_*` tools below remain for existing callers.
These `storage_*` tools move files to and from `storage.backend` records. Two gates apply before you touch anything: each backend has `mcp_read_enabled` / `mcp_write_enabled` switches (both default off), and the ORM ACL (group_system) still applies. Call `storage_list_backends` first to see which backends are open and their read/write flags.
Reading - `storage_list_files(backend, path)` and `storage_stat_file(backend, path)` browse and stat a backend-relative path. - `storage_read_file(backend, path)` returns small text files inline (up to 256 KiB); larger files come back `truncated` — fetch those by URL instead. - `storage_get_download_url(backend, path)` returns a temporary URL plus a curl command. Fetch it with curl; the bytes never travel through the tool channel.
Writing directly to a path - `storage_get_upload_url(backend, path, overwrite=False)` returns a temporary URL plus a curl command. `overwrite` must be True to replace an existing file. Upload with `curl -T <file> '<url>'`. - `storage_delete_file(backend, path)` deletes a file; destructive and irreversible.
Staged upload (handing a payload to another tool) Use this when a downstream tool (e.g. skillhub) consumes the file: 1. `storage_stage_upload(backend, filename)` -> returns a `file_id` + upload URL. 2. `curl -T <file> '<url>'` 3. `storage_commit_upload(file_id)` -> returns the verified `sha256` + `size`. 4. Pass `file_id` to the downstream tool.
The `file_id` is the only safe cross-tool reference — never pass a `(backend, path)` pair to a consumer. A `file_id` is single-shot (marked consumed on use) and auto-expires if never consumed.
